A horizontal timeline chart titled "Tense and aspect at a glance". A long arrow runs left to right, "NOW" (a vertical red line in the centre) and "FUTURE". Above the line, four colour-coded rows: "Simple" (single dots), "Progressive" (wavy bars showing ongoing action around a point), "Perfect" (an arrow ending at a reference point) and "Perfect progressive" (a wavy bar ending in an arrow at a reference point). Each row has three small examples placed at past, present and future positions: e.g. "cooked / cook / will cook", "was cooking / am cooking / will be cooking", "had cooked / have cooked / will have cooked", "had been cooking / have been cooking / will have been cooking".
